# Go Intervals

> Free browser timers: stopwatch, countdown, interval/HIIT, Tabata, EMOM and Pomodoro. No login, no ads, no server. Timing is timestamp-based so it does not drift when a tab is throttled or a phone sleeps. Keeps the screen on, beeps with generated tones, works offline after the first visit.

Site: https://gointervals.com
Source: https://github.com/nimi0112/gointervals
License: MIT, open source. Content may be quoted with attribution. Issues and contributions: https://github.com/nimi0112/gointervals/issues

## Timers

- [Home / interval timer](https://gointervals.com/): the interval timer with presets, including "beep every 10 minutes for 30 minutes".
- [Interval timer](https://gointervals.com/interval): work, rest, rounds, sets, rest between sets, saved presets.
- [Countdown timer](https://gointervals.com/timer): presets 1 to 60 minutes plus custom.
- [Stopwatch](https://gointervals.com/stopwatch): laps with split and total.
- [Tabata timer](https://gointervals.com/tabata): 20/10 x 8, editable.
- [EMOM timer](https://gointervals.com/emom): every minute on the minute, configurable interval.
- [Pomodoro timer](https://gointervals.com/pomodoro): 25/5, long break every 4, session counter.
- [Meditation timer](https://gointervals.com/meditation): one soft bell every 10 minutes for 30 minutes by default, interval and length editable, no ticks, screen stays awake.

- Countdowns: https://gointervals.com/timer/1-minute and https://gointervals.com/timer/{n}-minutes for n in 2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9,10,12,15,20,25,30,40,45,50,60,90 and https://gointervals.com/timer/{n}-seconds for n in 10,15,20,30,45,60,90.
